g.text: Register order in Luxury Concierge Queue;
Allocate certified inventory piece from high-security vault;
Generate Certificate of Authenticity & BIS Record
Transfer physical piece to Master Artisan Studio
Schedule high-security pickup with Sequel Secure Logistics;
Generate transit manifest & GPS custody handoff
Ultrasonic bath cleaning to remove artisan polishing residues
Affix Certificate of Authenticity & BIS Hallmarking Card;
Place jewellery in Anti-Tarnish Velvet Presentation Box
Pack inside Tamper-Evident Serialized Security Pouch;
Inspect serialized pouch seal integrity at Vault Handoff;
Log Location: 'In Transit - Sequel Armored Division'
Load inside 100% insured armored transit vehicle
Real-time route optimization & transit telemetry update
Arrival at Local Destination Express Hub;
Assign dedicated White-Glove Luxury Delivery Executive;
Dispatch automated client alert: "Keep Govt Photo ID Ready"
"Store in anti-tarnish velvet box for lasting brilliance."
Trigger immediate security escalation to ZAWER Concierge
Executive arrives at client destination address;
Request client Government Photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / DL)
Break tamper seal in front of client;
Hand over velvet presentation box & authenticity certificate
Collect payment (if COD) & obtain digital delivery sign-off
Client receives digital receipt & post-purchase care guide
